info.name: Pilotwardrobe API v1
info.description: Generated from docs/openapi.json by `php artisan dev:postman`. Set `baseUrl`, then run Auth / POST /auth/login (stores `token`).

request.description: `PATCH /admin/content/hero-slides/{id}` — edits are saved as a draft until published
`POST /admin/content/publish` — promotes drafts to live and purges the home cache
`PUT /admin/content/pages/{slug}` (addition) — CMS pages; HTML is sanitised on write
`POST /admin/exports` — queues a CSV of a table; the link is emailed when ready
`GET /admin/kyc/{id}` — documents as 10-minute signed URLs. Viewing is audit-logged
`POST /admin/orders/{id}/refund` — above the threshold this becomes a dual-control request
`POST /admin/orders/{id}/release` — lift a hold, or force-release escrow
`GET /admin/overview` — KPIs last 30 days vs the previous 30, queues filtered by the viewer's permissions
`POST /admin/payouts/approve` — `{ ids }`; the requester can never approve their own payout
`POST /admin/payouts/batches` — groups approved payouts per provider/currency and sends them
`PATCH /admin/roles/{id}` — the super admin role is immutable (409)
`PATCH /admin/settings` — gateway/escrow/dual-control changes require a second approver
`POST /admin/team/invitations` — staff accounts must use the company domain
`PATCH /admin/team/{id}` — change role or deactivate; the last super admin is protected (409)
`POST /admin/users/{id}/impersonate` — read-only 15-minute token; visible to the user
`POST /admin/users/{id}/role` — super_admin can never be granted here
`POST /auth/email-lookup` — does an account exist, and which sign-in methods does it have?
`POST /auth/password/forgot` — same response whether or not the email exists
`POST /auth/social/link` — link the social identity to an existing password account (VA8)
`GET /categories` — tree with counts (cached; busted when categories change)
`POST /contact` — works for visitors and signed-in users
`POST /conversations` — start or fetch the thread about a listing
`GET /conversations/{id}/messages` — newest page last; `before=<message id>` pages back
`GET /help/summary` — status comes from recorded checks, never hard-coded
`GET /listings/{slug}` — 404 for anything not publicly visible, except to its seller
`GET /listings/{slug}/related` — same category first, then same brand
`POST /listings/fee-quote` (public) — commission and net payout for a price
`POST /listings/bulk` — pause/resume/archive/price. Items in the wrong state are skipped
`POST /listings/{id}/reserve` — seller reserves for the buyer in a conversation
`POST /listings/{id}/promote` — creates a boost awaiting payment (pay via /payments/initialize with promotion_id)
`POST /me/deactivate` — hides listings until the next sign-in
`DELETE /me/social/{provider}` — 409 when it is the last sign-in method
`POST /me/two-factor` — start authenticator enrolment; returns secret + QR (SVG)
`DELETE /me/two-factor` — requires the current password and a valid code
`POST /me/two-factor/backup-codes` — regenerate backup codes (requires an authenticator code)
`GET /me/wallet?currency=` — defaults to the user's currency; other wallets listed in `wallets`
`POST /me/wallet/statements` — signed URL to a monthly statement PDF
`GET /me/payout-methods` (masked; full account numbers are never returned)
`POST /me/payout-methods` — validated with the PSP; stores only recipient codes + last 4
`DELETE /media/{id}` — unattached uploads owned by the caller only
`POST /orders/{order}/downloads/{asset}/authorize` — short-lived signed URL for purchased digital files
`GET /pages/{slug}` — `body_html` was sanitised when it was saved
`POST /payments/initialize` — idempotent per payable + gateway while pending
`GET /payments/{reference}` — server-verified status (verifies with the PSP when still open)
`POST /sandbox/payments/{reference}/{outcome}` — local/test only (mirrors the SPA mock gateway)
